title: ग्रामर: Did से सवाल
Grammar: Did se sawaal
Grammar in Use: questions with Did

card: बीते समय (past) के वाक्य को सवाल बनाना हो तो शुरू में ‘Did’ लगाओ और काम वाले शब्द को पहले रूप में करो: He had no ticket. → Did he have a ticket? (had → have)
Beete samay (past) ke vaakya ko sawaal banaana ho to shuru mein ‘Did’ lagao aur kaam waale shabd ko pehle roop mein karo: He had no ticket. → Did he have a ticket? (had → have)
To turn a past sentence into a question, put ‘Did’ first and use the base form of the verb: He had a ticket. → Did he have a ticket? (had → have)
याद रखो: Did के बाद हमेशा सीधा रूप: got → get, lived → live, paid → pay, started → start।
Yaad rakho: Did ke baad hamesha seedha roop: got → get, lived → live, paid → pay, started → start.
Remember: after Did, always the base form: got → get, lived → live, paid → pay, started → start.

card: शब्द के आगे re लगाने से मतलब ‘फिर से’ (rewrite = फिर से लिखना)। un लगाने से मतलब ‘नहीं’ (unhappy = ख़ुश नहीं)। पीछे ful लगाने से मतलब ‘भरा हुआ’ (wonderful)।
Shabd ke aage re lagaane se matlab ‘phir se’ (rewrite = phir se likhna). un lagaane se matlab ‘nahi’ (unhappy = khush nahi). Peechhe ful lagaane se matlab ‘bhara hua’ (wonderful).
‘re’ at the start means again (rewrite = write again). ‘un’ means not (unhappy = not happy). ‘ful’ at the end means full of (wonderful = full of wonder).
